Only 23% of 4,441 remote listings reveal pay. Here’s what that means for your job search.

New data from Loker Dollar shows that out of 4,441 active remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The rest—3,441 listings (77%)—keep compensation private. This challenges the idea that remote jobs are always upfront about pay.

But here’s the twist: 2,753 listings (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world. So while pay transparency is low, the opportunity to work from anywhere is high.

What skills are in demand? Communication leads (39% of 4,282 listings), followed by AI (12%), leadership (10%), sales (8%), project management (7%), and data analysis (7%).

Only one company in the spotlight—Neo Financial—discloses its rate ($5 USD/hour). TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether don’t.

The lack of pay info doesn’t mean low wages—many firms expect candidates to negotiate. Ready to find a role that pays in USD? Browse the live board and filter for “worldwide remote” before listings close.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
